title: Register for and pay payroll tax
what: Register with the state revenue office and pay payroll tax once wages paid in Australia pass the state's threshold.

sources.title: Payroll Tax Act 1971 (Qld)
sources.quote: An employer who is not already registered as an employer under this division and who meets the criteria for registration must, within 7 days after the end of the month during which the employer meets the criteria, give the commissioner an application for registration as an employer.

triggers.unit: AUD of taxable wages a financial year (annual threshold)
triggers.note: Registration is triggered month by month, when wages pass the monthly or weekly equivalent; groups share one threshold.

sources.title: Payroll Tax Act 1971 (Qld)
sources.quote: IW means the amount of interstate wages paid or payable in the year. K means 1,300,000.

reach.note: Every employer, by taxable wages; exemptions (e.g. some charities) are not yet recorded.

sources.title: Payroll Tax Act 1971 (Qld)
sources.quote: An employer who is not already registered as an employer under this division and who meets the criteria for registration must, within 7 days after the end of the month during which the employer meets the criteria, give the commissioner an application for registration as an employer.

confidence_note: The $1.3 million works as a deduction (s 29 formula), not a plain threshold; the registration criteria in s 52 are not yet quoted.
